rationale: Shiza's hands-on work in robotics and ML at the intersection of hardware and software complements Ainur's deep expertise in lab automation and robotics-manipulation—both are building practical AI and robotics solutions beyond pure research. Ainur's conviction that scientists need no-code interfaces to control robots aligns with Shiza's belief that the barrier to deploying custom ML models has dropped dramatically, and both could explore how humanoid or collaborative robots might unlock new possibilities in lab automation workflows.
intro_message: Shiza Charania, meet Ainur Nygmet — you're both bridging robotics engineering and applied ML to solve real-world problems, and Ainur's work standardizing lab automation interfaces could be a compelling use case for the kinds of deployable ML systems Shiza is building at Haptile.
